name: Dairy Queen
notes: This location is listed on dairyqueen.com as DQ Treat Only (not a Grill and Chill), which matches the DoorDash catalog exactly: Blizzards, shakes/malts, DQ Coolers/Sparklers/Misty, Dilly Bars, Buster Bars, hot dogs, and cakes -- no burgers, fries, or chicken baskets, because this store does not serve them. Own dairyqueen.com site and its /en-us/order/ Next.js storefront for store #12979 render no prices server-side (client-fetched); DoorDash JSON-LD (address-confirmed: 664 Palomar Street, Chula Vista) was the only source with real prices. Markup test: best-fit multiplier 1.20 hits only 15/49 (31%), below the threshold for a confirmed surcharge given odd-cent pricing throughout (.47, .59, .95, .19) -- read as organic pricing, not a marketplace markup, so not divided out. Grubhub listing found by search renders a client-side shell with no data, so no independent cross-check was reachable.
